districts.name: Downtown
districts.description: Neo Terra's corporate core: towers, plazas, and the institutions everyone pretends are independent.

districts.name: Harbor
districts.description: Container yards, docks, islands, and the unlicensed shipping that keeps Clarity's black market alive.

districts.name: Maple Heights
districts.description: Tree-lined residential blocks and the Matic estate. Civilian ground that villains keep making personal.

districts.name: Fashion Row
districts.description: Boutiques, ateliers, and Monicium showrooms. Superhero couture by day, image warfare by night.

districts.name: Civic Center
districts.description: Police headquarters, hospitals, and the administrative machinery that tries to keep metahuman incidents legible. No dedicated SVG polygon; its facilities are grouped from key locations.

districts.name: Industrial Belt
districts.description: Dead factories, salvage crews, warehouses, and the kind of quiet that hides laboratories and bodies.

districts.name: Coast
districts.description: Beaches, islands, and Sand Shine Town. The city's edge, where storms and old grief wash ashore.

districts.name: Old Hills
districts.description: Old money, lake parks, forested ridges, and the Renya shrine hidden where the city forgets to look.

districts.name: Outskirts
districts.description: Airports, containment facilities, and the long roads out of Neo Terra. Officially outside the action; never actually safe.

districts.name: Underground
districts.description: Sealed subway tunnels and unlisted facilities beneath the city. No polygon; travel is authored through secret edges.
